The '''Glavis Ringworld''',<ref name="Databank">{{Databank|glavis-ringworld|Glavis Ringworld}}</ref> also known simply as '''Glavis''',<ref name="Map" /> was a [[space station]] that encircled a small [[star]]<ref name="Databank" /> in the [[Glavis system]] of the [[Core Worlds]].<ref name="Appendix" /> It was located in grid quare M-11 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]] and lay on the [[Hydian Way]] between [[Exodeen]] and the [[Trellen system]].<ref name="Map" /> The station's surface was constantly bathed in sunlight.<ref name="Databank" /> Day and night cycles artificially occurred due to the sunlight that passed through the open loop.<ref name="Chapter 5 audio description">Per the audio description for "[[Chapter 5: Return of the Mandalorian]]" available on [[Disney+]].</ref> Eclipse plates slid over its sunward face, providing an artificial night cycle.<ref name="Databank" /> The ring featured areas open to [[Realspace|space]] on both surfaces, although there was atmosphere. The ring maintained consistent<ref name="Chapter 5" /> [[artificial gravity]]<ref name="Junior Novel">[[The Book of Boba Fett Junior Novel|''The Book of Boba Fett'' Junior Novel]]</ref> downward relative to the interior surface. As a result, incautious behavior on walkways in maintenance areas on the outer surface of the ring could result in beings falling off the ring.<ref name="Chapter 5" />

The open-looped ring world contained a [[city]] home to a variety of [[species]]. During the [[New Republic Era]], [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Din Djarin]] visited the ring to find [[the Tribe]].<ref name="Chapter 5" />
